content: He who respects the living waters will never perish of thirst in the desert.
author: Native American Proverbs
explanation: Water is not a commercial commodity to be bottled, hoarded, and polluted; water is the primary lifeblood of Mother Earth. Those who approach springs with offerings of corn pollen, thanksgiving, and protective stewardship find that the springs remain sweet and faithful through every drought.
practicalInsight: Drink a glass of fresh water with total gratitude and reverence today. Honor the water of life.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your life have you been treating the vital resources that keep you alive with casual, ungrateful disrespect?
